dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And this is the living room.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈðɪs ɪz ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ˌruːm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, there's a big sofa! And a TV!
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ðɛrz ə ˈbɪɡ ˈsoʊfə! ənd ə ˌtiːˈviː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. My family watches TV here at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. maɪ ˈfæməli ˈwɑːtʃɪz ˌtiːˈviː ˈhɪr ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, there is. There are two mango trees in the garden.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛr ˈɪz. ðɛr ər ˈtuː ˈmæŋɡoʊ ˌtriːz ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːrdən.
